units.source_text: 源氏公子想起山中大堰邸内的明石姬，失去了孩子之后何等寂寞，觉得很对她不起。

en.t: Prince Genji thought of Lady Akashi at the Oi residence in the mountains, imagined how lonely she must be after losing her child, and felt deeply sorry toward her.

units.source_text: 但见紫姬朝夜爱抚这孩子，又觉十分如意称心。

en.t: Yet when he saw Lady Murasaki caring tenderly for the child morning and night, he also felt that everything had turned out entirely to his satisfaction.

units.source_text: 所可惜者，这孩子不是她亲生的。

en.t: The only regret was that the child was not her own by birth.

units.source_text: 倘是亲生，外人便无可非议。

en.t: If she had been her natural child, outsiders would have had nothing to criticize.
That was truly the one flaw in an otherwise perfect arrangement.

units.source_text: 小女公子初来的几天内，有时啼啼哭哭，要找一向熟悉的人。

en.t: During the first few days after the little princess arrived, she sometimes cried and sobbed, wanting to find the people she had always known.

units.source_text: 但这孩子本性温和驯良，对紫姬十分亲昵，因此紫姬很疼爱她，仿佛获得了一件宝贝。

en.t: But the child was gentle and obedient by nature, and became very affectionate toward Lady Murasaki, so Lady Murasaki cherished her as though she had gained a treasure.
She held her all day long and played with her to amuse her.

units.source_text: 那乳母便自然而然地和夫人熟悉起来。

en.t: The nurse, too, naturally became familiar with the lady.

units.source_text: 他们又另外物色一个身份高贵而有乳的人，相帮哺育这孩子。

en.t: They also sought out another woman of noble rank who had milk, so that she could help nurse and raise the child.
